senses.sense_definition: The outer layer of an internal organ or body structure, such as the kidney or the brain.

examples.text: The cerebral <w>cortex</w> is responsible for many higher-level functions like thought and language.
Damage to the renal <w>cortex</w> can significantly affect how the body filters waste products.

senses.sense_definition: The tissue of a plant stem or root that lies between the epidermis and the vascular tissue.

examples.text: In many plants, the <w>cortex</w> serves as a storage area for starch and other nutrients.
The cells within the root <w>cortex</w> are often loosely packed to allow for gas exchange.

senses.sense_definition: The outer, weathered surface of a piece of flint or other stone.

examples.text: Archaeologists often examine the <w>cortex</w> of a stone tool to determine how it was manufactured.
The white <w>cortex</w> on the outside of the flint nodule was removed during the knapping process.
